items.label: Latest Android 15 & Powerful Octa-Core Performance
items.value: Powered by the latest Android 15 OS and a robust 2.0GHz octa-core processor, the SUAAT S3 tablet delivers exceptional speed and efficiency. Experience seamless multitasking, lightning-fast app launches, and extended battery life for all your needs

items.label: 64GB Storage & GMS Certification
items.value: With 64GB built-in storage (expandable to 2TB) and 30GB RAM (8GB physical + 22GB virtual), you don’t need to delete favorite games or videos to free up space. This GMS-certified Android tablet has authorized access to YouTube and other apps, ensuring compatibility and security

items.label: 10-Inch Eye-Care IPS Display & Widevine L1
items.value: Enjoy a vivid visual experience on the IPS full-screen display. This 10 inch tablet is certified by Widevine L1, offering HD quality while reducing harmful blue light, protecting your eyes and providing a comfortable reading, gaming, and streaming experience

items.label: 6000mAh All-Day Battery & Dual Speakers for Immersive Audio
items.value: This Android 15 tablet is equipped with a robust 6000mAh battery that supports all-day use on a single charge. Paired with dual stereo speakers, it produces rich and immersive audio—perfectly suited for movies, music, gaming, and more

items.label: Wi-Fi 6 & BT 5.0
items.value: Empowered by advanced Wi-Fi 6 (2.4/5GHz) and BT 5.0 technology, S3 tablet delivers blazing-fast speeds, a rock-solid connection even in congested areas, and enhanced power efficiency. Pair seamlessly and enjoy smooth HD streaming, lag-free gaming, and effortless multitasking

items.label: Dual Camera & Face Unlock
items.value: SUAAT tablets feature a 5MP high-resolution front camera and an 8MP AI rear camera, making them ideal for video calls, document scanning, and creative projects. Weighing just 1 lb with a remarkably slim 6mm profile, the SUAAT tablet is your ideal companion for on-the-go studying and entertainment
